runs.name: Xcel Energy Inc.; Nasdaq XEL, SEC CIK 0000072903, formerly Northern States Power Co /MN/ until 2000; Minneapolis regulated electric and natural gas delivery company, about 3.9 million electric and 2.2 million gas customers in eight states through NSP-Minnesota, NSP-Wisconsin, PSCo and SPS; an equity distribution agreement 2026-05-01 and forward sales for 69.8M shares; Minnesota rate stability plan filed 2026-10-09; the 10-K names no rival, Ameren, CMS and Alliant chosen as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and the competitors derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Price **$77.86** (close 2026-10-26, aggregator, flagged) x **624,634,306 shares** (10-Q cover for the period ended 2026-06-30, accession 0000072903-26-000154, via cover_shares.py, checked against the balance sheet and the proxy; forward sales for 69.8M more shares unissued, beside) = cap **$48,634M**; sovereign **5.31%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-26). **Q1 IN** (a regulated return on rate base in eight states; a $60B 2026-2030 capital plan, its financing and the allowed returns published). **Q2 IN on the deciding part, regulated electric** (88.6% of segment net income 2023 to 2025; 115,000 miles of transmission and 225,000 of distribution no attacker rebuilds; the regulator-set return read as the exception, not the OUT); narrowing at the edges: wildfire liability, PSCo earning 7.55% ongoing against about 9.3% allowed, a Minnesota base-rate freeze offered 2026-10-09. The 10-K names no rival company; Ameren, CMS and Alliant chosen as a CONVENTION of the run: all four earn about 10% to 12% on equity over 2016 to 2025, all consume cash, XEL issues shares fastest. **Q3 weighs against** ($23.5B more capital 2020 to 2025 earning about 4.4% after tax, about 6% to 7% on the added equity; about two points of consolidated ROE from holding-company debt). **Q4 IN on the accounts, weighs against** (the featured ongoing EPS; its habits carried to Q5). **Q5 OUT on integrity, on doubt**: 2025 guidance $3.75 to $3.85 named no bond-repurchase gain; the parent bought $787M face of its subsidiary's bonds for $607M, a $162M pre-tax gain, about $99M of it in the fourth quarter after O&M guidance was raised in the third; ongoing EPS about $3.58 without it against $3.80 reported, below the range, while the same ongoing figure excluded the $298M Marshall wildfire charge; 2024 the same shape ($3.50 reported against $3.50 to $3.60, about $3.43 without that year's gain); the annual incentive funded only if ongoing EPS reaches guidance, paid 143.76% of target for 2025; a 21-year streak of meeting guidance advertised; judged under L2002-041, M2010-001, L2016-006 and M2013-088, the record for the other side written down beside (GAAP first and reconciled, the gain disclosed, no restatement, candid risk factors). Q6 to Q12 NOT REACHED. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE beneath the stop: owner cash 2021 to 2025 equity-only $1,336M a year after maintenance (depreciation plus nuclear fuel amortization, the guess), -$2,598M after all spending, negative every year; growth shown 28.8% cut under (f) to sales growth of 2.23%; utility debt credit $1,834M in year one at a 46.6% allowed debt share, binding; the growth case below the no-growth case. Value range **$20.13 to $40.29 a share equity-only (central)**; 2.75% at the price for the no-growth case, none earning the floor, so a Q7 reached would also have closed OUT; fair price $11.91 equity-only, all-equity -$46.26, not positive; not armed, the box being OUT at Q5. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed: common stock issued $3,349M in 2025, shares 507.2M (2016) to 623.6M (2025), ATM programs of $4.0B and $4.3B, 69.8M shares sold forward at about $74; no repurchases; debt $40.8B at 2026-06-30, 1.70 times equity; interest coverage about 3.6x (2016) to 2.2x (2025); Smokehouse Creek insurance nearly spent, a Texas Attorney General suit. Framework gaps for the operator: the utility debt credit counting finance leases whose assets never pass through capital spending; the cap's weighting without rate base by state, whether a verbal decision or pending settlement counts as stated, and holding-company leverage above the allowed structure; specific (a) for an aberrational year reversing inside the window (Winter Storm Uri); specific (f)'s sales-growth fallback where fuel pass-through dominates revenue; production tax credits passed to customers under Whose tax; forward equity sales in the share count; no sentence on a non-operating gain kept inside the featured figure, which decided this file; the template's Q7 lines for a capped credit; tools/run.py's debt-table sum adding tags that are not debt. Could not get: electric rate base by state in one table, the combined statutory tax rate (21% used for the gain per share), CMS and Alliant capex tags for 2023 to 2025. Ordering departure declared by the analyst: the Q7 arithmetic was written and run during research and its result seen before Q5 was judged; its output headed COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE. Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths, last `cf9b9e52`. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; 91 id citations resolve, no E-ids, no citation slip, 35 quote-id pairs checked (`dispatcher_cite_check2.py`; the tight-adjacency script mispaired quotes and found one); no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: a WEC commit subject, an ARCB research-folder name in git status, the operator's memory lines; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q5 on integrity, on doubt (Xcel Energy, XEL; Minneapolis electric and gas utility in eight states; Q1 IN; Q2 IN on regulated electric, 88.6% of segment net income, the castle narrowing at the edges with wildfire and Colorado lag; Q3 and Q4 against; Q5 OUT: the featured ongoing EPS reached 2025 guidance only with a $162M bond-repurchase gain the guidance did not name, about $3.58 without it against $3.80 reported and a $3.75 floor, while the $298M Marshall wildfire charge was excluded from the same figure, 2024 the same shape, the bonus funded only at guidance and paid 143.76%; computation only: equity-only value range $20.13 to $40.29 vs $77.86, 2.75% at the price, fair $11.91 equity-only, all-equity not positive; no citation slip; not held; not armed; framework gaps for the operator: a non-operating gain inside the featured figure, the debt-credit cap and finance leases, (a) and (f) for a utility, credits passed to customers, forward equity sales; the analyst declared a WEC commit subject, an ARCB folder name and memory lines, none used)
